outcome.reason: Customer was unable to provide a specific payment date or amount, and did not want a callback.

transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma speaking. How can I help you?

Thank you for confirming. I’m calling regarding your Mumbai Bank credit card. As of today, there is a minimum amount due of Rs 4,820, which was due on 2026-10-15. 

Could you please let me know when you will be able to make this payment, and for how much?
I understand, and I’m planning to pay the amount soon, just need a few days to arrange it. Please don’t worry about it.

Thank you for letting me know, Mr. Sharma. Could you please specify the date by which you expect to make the payment, and the amount you intend to pay? This will help us update your account accurately.
I’m not sure about an exact date yet, but it will definitely be within a few days, and I’ll pay the full amount.

Thank you for sharing that. Could you please provide a specific date within the next 14 days by which you intend to make the payment, and confirm the amount you will pay? This helps us keep your records up to date. If you’re unable to provide a date right now, I can arrange for a callback at a time that’s convenient for you. What would you prefer?
I appreciate that, but I really don’t have a specific date right now. I’ll just pay soon, so no need for a callback.
